data.long_meaning: Jahanaara is derived from the Arabic word 'jann' meaning 'garden'. In Islamic spiritual traditions, it symbolizes the paradise or the Garden of Eden. The name signifies the one who brings joy, peace, and beauty to the garden of life. The name Jahanaara carries the meaning “Lady of the Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jahanaara usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
